headline: OpenAI faces 30 more lawsuits tied to Tumbler Ridge shooting
context: Edelson PC is filing 30 new lawsuits against OpenAI over the Tumbler Ridge shooting, escalating claims to aiding and abetting and naming Chris Lehane, though evidence remains unconfirmed.
